intro: Mods from the old CampD server that are not on the current 4.1.2 pack. Names were matched against Forge.

mods.name: Battle Ambience
mods.description: Adds distant gunfire and combat atmosphere so maps do not feel empty between fights.
mods.notes: Old list name matched Forge exactly. Latest Forge listing still targets SPT 4.0.

mods.name: FikaSync
mods.description: Fika helper that keeps ambience and similar client audio mods in sync during co-op.
mods.notes: No separate 'Battle Ambience (Fika Sync)' Forge page. Closest current listing is FikaSync. Only relevant if we bring Fika back.

mods.name: Color Converter API
mods.description: Shared color-conversion library other client UI mods depend on. Not useful by itself.
mods.notes: We already run More Tag Colours, which historically needed this API. Confirm whether 4.1.2 still requires it as a separate install.

mods.name: Don't Shoot The Bus
mods.description: Stops bots from lighting up the Ground Zero bus / extract vehicle.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing targets SPT 4.0.x.

mods.name: Expanded Task Text (ETT)
mods.description: Puts the full quest description and extra task text on the tasks screen instead of truncated blurbs.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing still shows SPT 3.11. May not have a 4.1.2 build yet.

mods.name: Headshot Darkness
mods.description: Darkens the screen on a headshot so that kill feedback is obvious.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing is SPT 4.0, not 4.1.

mods.name: Hide Beta Rework
mods.description: Reworks hideout hide-beta / stash-hide presentation so that UI is less noisy.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing is SPT 4.0, not 4.1.

mods.name: Hide Top Glow
mods.description: Removes the bright UI glow along the top of the screen.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing is SPT 4.0, not 4.1.

mods.name: Increase Climb Height
mods.description: Lets you vault / climb slightly higher ledges than vanilla SPT.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing is SPT 4.0, not 4.1.

mods.name: Item Preview QoL + screenshots
mods.description: Improves inspect previews and lets you grab cleaner item screenshots.
mods.notes: Separate from Preview Sizer, which is already installed. Latest listing targets SPT 4.0.x.

mods.name: Knight Mask Fix (4.0+)
mods.description: Fixes Death Knight mask clipping / visor issues on current SPT faces.
mods.notes: Picked the 4.0+ listing over the older 3.11 'Death Knight Mask Fix'.

mods.name: Less Restricting Headwear
mods.description: Relaxes helmet / headset / face-cover combo rules so more kits actually equip together.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing targets SPT 4.0.

mods.name: Level Endurance and Strength
mods.description: Lets endurance and strength level without the usual vanilla grind gates.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing targets SPT 4.0.13.

mods.name: Looting Bots
mods.description: Bots loot corpses and containers instead of standing on piles of gear.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing is SPT 4.0, not 4.1. Heavy overlap with other bot mods — check SAIN/APBS compatibility before adding.

mods.name: Lots of Loot Redux
mods.description: Turns up loose loot and container density across maps.
mods.notes: Forge has a 4.1-compatible listing.

mods.name: MoreCheckmarks
mods.description: Extra quest/hideout/handbook checkmarks so you can see what you still need.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing is SPT 4.0, not 4.1.

mods.name: More Energy Drinks
mods.description: Adds extra energy-drink items into loot and traders.
mods.notes: Forge listing shows SPT 4.1.x.

mods.name: Mortar Strikes
mods.description: Random or event mortar barrages during raids.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing targets SPT 4.0.x.

mods.name: NARCONet - Mod Sync
mods.description: Fika sync helper for NARCONet / stim-related client mods.
mods.notes: The old name was just NarcoNet. Current Forge hit is the Fika sync package, which needs 4.0 and Fika. Original overlay may be gone or renamed.

mods.name: Project Fika
mods.description: Co-op client for playing SPT raids with other people.
mods.notes: Client package. The matching server package is Project Fika - Server (id 2357). This is a co-op stack, not a drop-in for the current dedicated SPT server.

mods.name: (Completed + FIKA) Quests Extended
mods.description: Extra / restored quests, including Fika-friendly completed-state handling.
mods.notes: Closest current Forge listing for 'Quests Extended'. Targets SPT 4.0 and is Fika-oriented.

mods.name: SAIN - Solarint's AI Modifications - Full AI Combat System Replacement
mods.description: Replaces vanilla bot combat brains: peeks, nades, holds, and push logic.
mods.notes: Huge stack. Latest listing still shows SPT 4.0. Conflicts / overlaps with the APBS + ABPS setup we already run — do not add blindly.

mods.name: Show Me The Money (Item Pricing)
mods.description: Shows flee / trader prices on items in stash and raid so you know what loot is worth.
mods.notes: Overlaps LootNET, which is already installed. Latest listing targets SPT 4.0.x.

mods.name: Smooth Talker
mods.description: Smooths trader / dialogue UI so conversations are less clunky.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing is SPT 4.0, not 4.1.

mods.name: Temporary Fixes
mods.description: Bundle of short-term client/server bug workarounds for a specific SPT patch.
mods.notes: Latest listing is gated to SPT 4.0.0–4.0.13. Probably obsolete on 4.1.2.

mods.name: Updated collector quest and streamer case (EFT 1.0 Backport)
mods.description: Brings the live-wipe Collector / streamer-case quest changes into SPT.
mods.notes: Closest Forge match for the old name. Listing is SPT 4.0.13.

mods.name: WikiLinks
mods.description: Adds tarkov.help / wiki links on item inspect so you can look up quests and barters quickly.
mods.notes: Latest Forge listing targets SPT 4.0.

mods.name: Healing Autocancel
mods.description: Cancels the heal animation when you move or take damage so you are not locked in place.
mods.notes: Forge page is Healing Autocancel. Latest listing targets SPT 4.0.

mods.name: UnderFire - An Adrenaline Effect
mods.description: Adds an adrenaline / incoming-fire effect when you are being shot at.
mods.notes: Forge page is UnderFire - An Adrenaline Effect. Latest listing targets SPT 4.0.
